cases.goal: 가구 랜딩 페이지 리디자인을 실제 UI 레퍼런스 리서치와 새 디자인 시스템 수립부터 진행해줘
observable_criteria: Researches exact-task shipped states and transfer limits before choosing the visual language
Defines a proportional foundation, semantic-token, component, and lifecycle contract without inventing unused system layers
Maps every material landing-page decision to realistic Korean, responsive, and rendered scenarios
forbidden_behaviors: Uses broad style adjectives or one attractive reference as the decision authority
Chooses untraceable spacing, typography, radius, color, or imagery values
Calls an unrendered landing page coherent or verified

cases.goal: 영화 탐색 UI page redesign 해줘. 카드, 필터, 테이블과 data visualization의 정보 구조 리서치도 해줘
observable_criteria: Chooses cards, tables, filters, and visualization encodings from browse, compare, inspect, and decision tasks
Defines shared component anatomy, variants, states, content extremes, and semantic-token lineage across the feature-rich page
Verifies realistic dense, empty, loading, partial-failure, narrow, and localized states
forbidden_behaviors: Treats a card grid as the default representation for every movie datum
Styles each feature independently without a shared system contract
Uses visual-diff success as the only quality verdict

cases.goal: 새 결제 primary button design을 해줘. 기존 컴포넌트에 맞는지 판단하고 긴 한국어 라벨과 상태를 검증해줘
observable_criteria: Classifies action, priority, consequence, reversibility, permission, and state before visual treatment
Derives control dimensions from the project control role, content metrics, target-size constraint, icon gap, and density context
Checks the consuming page with long Korean content and every relevant interaction and outcome state
forbidden_behaviors: Selects button pixels, color, radius, or margin because they look appropriate
Uses 44 or 48 pixels as a universal WCAG AA button rule
Promotes one attractive render directly to a stable reusable primitive

cases.goal: 기존 제품 UI의 결제 버튼을 이미 승인된 stable component와 semantic spacing token으로만 교정해줘. 의미, 위계, 상태, 토큰은 바꾸지 않아
observable_criteria: Allows compact execution only after unchanged semantics, hierarchy, states, localization, and accessibility certainty are each backed by current content-addressed project-system evidence
Binds the referenced stable component and semantic tokens to an exact current inventory and digest rather than accepting eligibility booleans as proof
Keeps exactly one bounded decision and one render scenario with existing-token or component-contract lineage only
Requires a fully decoded PNG whose dimensions match the declared viewport and whose scenario is the real consuming page
forbidden_behaviors: Opens a full design-system research project for proven stable token reuse
Accepts self-attested compact eligibility or invented evidence references
Introduces a raw local value, owner preference, derived local value, or new variant under compact mode
Accepts a signature-only, non-decodable, or viewport-mismatched image as rendered verification

cases.goal: 회원가입 UI form design과 validation, 키보드 포커스 검증, 오류 복구를 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Defines labels, constraints, prevention, validation timing, input preservation, textual errors, correction, announcement, focus, confirmation, and recovery
Binds input and action variants to existing semantic tokens and relevant state contracts
Verifies keyboard, zoom, autofill, paste, long localized content, failure, and recovery in context
forbidden_behaviors: Treats field border styling as a complete form design
Makes live validation the default without user evidence
Drops entered data or hides recovery after an error

cases.goal: 한국어 UI 타이포그래피 리서치로 글자 역할, 위계, 폰트 fallback과 긴 라벨 렌더링을 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Classifies text by product job and intended reading order before choosing size, weight, line height, measure, or family
Uses a real corpus spanning Hangul, Latin, numerals, units, symbols, punctuation, errors, long labels, weights, and narrow widths
Derives semantic type tokens from actual font metrics and rendered content with fallback and loading evidence
forbidden_behaviors: Copies a foreign type scale as universal Korean UI values
Creates hierarchy primarily by accumulating arbitrary sizes, weights, colors, and families
Approves typography from a font-family declaration without browser renders

cases.goal: 제품 디자인 웹 디자인 화면 디자인 사용자 인터페이스의 새 시각 언어, 새 디자인 시스템, 새 토큰 계열, 새 컴포넌트 프리미티브를 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Uses system scope with complete foundations, semantic roles, component taxonomy, lifecycle, provenance, representative fixtures, and held-out evaluation
Introduces component tokens only where a distinct reusable component decision requires them
Records adopted and rejected reference transfers and a bounded adoption or migration path
forbidden_behaviors: Uses compact mode for a new visual language or token family
Builds unused token tiers and component abstractions for completeness
Treats DTCG format conformance as proof that the token values are good design

cases.goal: 백엔드 스케줄러의 재시도, 멱등성, backoff와 dead-letter queue를 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Keeps backend scheduling and recovery semantics outside Product Design assurance
forbidden_behaviors: Selects Product Design because the backend request contains state or flow concepts

cases.goal: 랜딩페이지에 scroll-triggered pin, scrub, parallax 장면과 reduced-motion 대체를 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Leaves detailed scroll-linked choreography and runtime mechanics to interactive-web-motion
forbidden_behaviors: Uses Product Design assurance as a substitute for motion mechanism and performance expertise

cases.goal: 개발자 운영 대시보드의 작업 실행 의존 그래프를 디자인 레퍼런스 조사와 정보 구조 리서치로 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Preserves raw typed relations and execution provenance while testing any reduced display projection
Uses dependency waves and contextual detail to support operator investigation without inventing measured facts
Verifies dense forks, joins, selection, focus, reflow, localization, natural scrolling, and a linear alternative
forbidden_behaviors: Loads the operational Guide from generic backend graph vocabulary alone
Presents requested model, token, or timing settings as observed facts
Uses a wide canvas as the only chronology representation
